title: The SiteOrigin CSS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'class'…
description: The SiteOrigin CSS plugin for WordPress up to version 1.6.9 is vulnerable to stored DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'class' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing attackers with contributor-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts into posts. These scripts execute when users with the edit_theme_options capability interact with the Visual Inspector on the affected post. Unauthenticated exploitation requires additional third-party plugin configurations and moderator approval, which are not present in default installations.
